alert_only.description: If true, only return coins with MILD_DEPEG or worse. Useful for alert-driven workflows.

symbol.description: Filter to a specific stablecoin symbol (e.g. USDT, USDC, DAI). Case-insensitive. If omitted, returns top coins by market cap.

top_n.description: Number of top stablecoins to return, ranked by circulating supply. Default 20, max 50. Ignored if symbol is specified.

Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.07 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Real-time depeg monitor for top USD stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI, USDS, and others ranked by market cap). Returns current price, peg deviation %, depeg status (PARITY / MILD_DEPEG / MODERATE_DEPEG / SEVERE_DEPEG), supply trend, and a composite alert level (GREEN / YELLOW / ORANGE / RED). Sourced from DeFiLlama public API — no key required, updates every call. Useful for DeFi risk management, collateral health checks, and pre-trade regime detection.
